description: pkix-lint/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs:176-296 — The 100-day and 47-day phase tests were added and do use real DER fixtures (leaf-p256-110d-post-sc081-100d.der, leaf-p256-50d-post-sc081-100d.der, leaf-p256-50d-post-sc081-47d.der, leaf-p256-45d-post-sc081-47d.der). The fixture-only tests (validity_max_error_110d_in_100d_phase, validity_max_pass_50d_in_100d_phase, etc.) are present and not #[ignore]'d, which is good. However the tests validity_max_cap_function_100d_phase and validity_max_cap_function_47d_phase test sc081_validity_cap() directly via pkix_profiles::sc081_validity_cap — this function is under test. These are unit tests on the oracle function itself, not independent verification. They pass vacuously if sc081_validity_cap is wrong in a self-consistent way. The cap function tests should be documented as 'oracle: CA/B Forum text, independent of lint code' or cross-checked against an external epoch calculation, not just confirm that sc081_validity_cap(T) == sc081_validity_cap(T).
title: SC-081 100d/47d fixture tests still #[ignore]-free but use cap function, not DER fixtures
